_comment: ÐMP Collection Manifest — Dynamic Supply (type: dynamic, criteria: rule_based)
_doc: This is the canonical form for an ever-expanding collection like DogeMaps DNS registrations. No supply cap is set. Membership is determined by evaluating rules against each inscription's metadata — any indexer can independently verify membership without a signed update from the creator.
name: DogeMaps Domains
description: Every .doge domain name registered through the DogeMaps on-chain DNS protocol. An open, ever-expanding registry — new domains are added automatically as they are registered.

criteria._comment: All three rules must match (AND logic). Any inscription satisfying all rules is automatically a member — no creator signature needed per-item.

rules._note: The inscription's JSON body must have p:dogemap.
Only domain registration ops count — not updates or transfers.

_signing_note: Same signing procedure as fixed manifests. sig covers canonical JSON of all fields except sig/sig_msg.
